measurements.evidence_quote: Furthermore, the zeta-potential (-15.9 ± 6.63 MV) indicated that the PS-NPs were slightly negatively charged to facilitate their suspension in ultrapure water (Supplementary Fig. 1 C). || Hydrodynamic diameters and zeta potentials were measured in ultrapure water using a Zetasizer Nano ZS instrument (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, UK).
